title: F01 in the Treatment of Moderate-to-severe Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Phase I Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Preliminary Efficacy of F01 in Patients With Moderate-to-severe Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
summary: This is a phase I clinical study to evaluate the safety , pharmacokinetic profile, and preliminary efficacy of F01 in patients with moderate-to-severe refractory systemic lupus erythematosus.
desc: Approximately up to about 50 participants with moderate-to-severe refractory systemic lupus erythematosus are planned to enroll. This study is divided into two stages: dose escalation and dose extension.

arms.l: Experimental: After preconditioning with chemotherapy, F01 will be evaluated.
i: Biological: After preconditioning with chemotherapy, F01 will be evaluated.

interventions.n: After preconditioning with chemotherapy, F01 will be evaluated.
